[{"text":"コーヒーをお願いします。","reading":"Koohii o onegai shimasu.","kana":"こーひーをおねがいします。","romaji":"Koohii o onegai shimasu.","english":"Coffee, please.","burmese":"ကော်ဖီ တစ်ခွက် ပေးပါ။"},{"text":"よろしくお願いします。","reading":"Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.","kana":"よろしくおねがいします。","romaji":"Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.","english":"Nice to meet you. / I look forward to working with you.","burmese":"ခင်ခင်မင်မင် ဆက်ဆံပေးပါ။"},{"text":"駅までお願いします。","reading":"Eki made onegai shimasu.","kana":"えきまでおねがいします。","romaji":"Eki made onegai shimasu.","english":"To the station, please.","burmese":"ဘူတာအထိ ပို့ပေးပါ။"}]

[{"text":"廊下を走らないでください。","reading":"Rouka o hashiranaide kudasai.","kana":"ろうかをはしらないでください。","romaji":"Rouka o hashiranaide kudasai.","english":"Please don't run in the hallway.","burmese":"စင်္ကြံမှာ မပြေးပါနဲ့။"},{"text":"トイレは廊下の右にあります。","reading":"Toire wa rouka no migi ni arimasu.","kana":"といれはろうかのみぎにあります。","romaji":"Toire wa rouka no migi ni arimasu.","english":"The toilet is on the right side of the hallway.","burmese":"အိမ်သာက စင်္ကြံရဲ့ ညာဘက်မှာ ရှိတယ်။"},{"text":"廊下で先生に会いました。","reading":"Rouka de sensei ni aimashita.","kana":"ろうかでせんせいにあいました。","romaji":"Rouka de sensei ni aimashita.","english":"I met the teacher in the hallway.","burmese":"စင်္ကြံမှာ ဆရာနဲ့ တွေ့ခဲ့တယ်။"}]

[{"text":"この町は人が多いです。","reading":"Kono machi wa hito ga ooi desu.","kana":"このまちはひとがおおいです。","romaji":"Kono machi wa hito ga ooi desu.","english":"There are a lot of people in this town.","burmese":"ဒီမြို့မှာ လူများတယ်။"},{"text":"今日は宿題が多いです。","reading":"Kyou wa shukudai ga ooi desu.","kana":"きょうはしゅくだいがおおいです。","romaji":"Kyou wa shukudai ga ooi desu.","english":"There's a lot of homework today.","burmese":"ဒီနေ့ အိမ်စာ များတယ်။"},{"text":"六月は雨が多いです。","reading":"Rokugatsu wa ame ga ooi desu.","kana":"ろくがつはあめがおおいです。","romaji":"Rokugatsu wa ame ga ooi desu.","english":"It rains a lot in June.","burmese":"ဇွန်လမှာ မိုးများတယ်။"}]

[{"text":"この町は人が少ないです。","reading":"Kono machi wa hito ga sukunai desu.","kana":"このまちはひとがすくないです。","romaji":"Kono machi wa hito ga sukunai desu.","english":"There are few people in this town.","burmese":"ဒီမြို့မှာ လူနည်းတယ်။"},{"text":"今月はお金が少ないです。","reading":"Kongetsu wa okane ga sukunai desu.","kana":"こんげつはおかねがすくないです。","romaji":"Kongetsu wa okane ga sukunai desu.","english":"I'm short on money this month.","burmese":"ဒီလ ပိုက်ဆံ နည်းနေတယ်။"},{"text":"このクラスは学生が少ないです。","reading":"Kono kurasu wa gakusei ga sukunai desu.","kana":"このくらすはがくせいがすくないです。","romaji":"Kono kurasu wa gakusei ga sukunai desu.","english":"This class has few students.","burmese":"ဒီအတန်းမှာ ကျောင်းသား နည်းတယ်။"}]

[{"text":"薬屋で風邪の薬を買いました。","reading":"Kusuriya de kaze no kusuri o kaimashita.","kana":"くすりやでかぜのくすりをかいました。","romaji":"Kusuriya de kaze no kusuri o kaimashita.","english":"I bought cold medicine at the drugstore.","burmese":"ဆေးဆိုင်မှာ အအေးမိဆေး ဝယ်ခဲ့တယ်။"},{"text":"この近くに薬屋はありますか。","reading":"Kono chikaku ni kusuriya wa arimasu ka.","kana":"このちかくにくすりやはありますか。","romaji":"Kono chikaku ni kusuriya wa arimasu ka.","english":"Is there a drugstore near here?","burmese":"ဒီနားမှာ ဆေးဆိုင် ရှိလား။"},{"text":"薬屋は駅の前にあります。","reading":"Kusuriya wa eki no mae ni arimasu.","kana":"くすりやはえきのまえにあります。","romaji":"Kusuriya wa eki no mae ni arimasu.","english":"The drugstore is in front of the station.","burmese":"ဆေးဆိုင်က ဘူတာရှေ့မှာ ရှိတယ်။"}]

[{"text":"七時に起きます。","reading":"Shichiji ni okimasu.","kana":"しちじにおきます。","romaji":"Shichiji ni okimasu.","english":"I get up at seven.","burmese":"ခုနစ်နာရီမှာ ထတယ်။"},{"text":"一週間は七日です。","reading":"Isshuukan wa nanoka desu.","kana":"いっしゅうかんはなのかです。","romaji":"Isshuukan wa nanoka desu.","english":"A week has seven days.","burmese":"တစ်ပတ်မှာ ခုနစ်ရက် ရှိတယ်။"},{"text":"七番のバスに乗ってください。","reading":"Nanaban no basu ni notte kudasai.","kana":"ななばんのばすにのってください。","romaji":"Nanaban no basu ni notte kudasai.","english":"Please take bus number seven.","burmese":"နံပါတ်ခုနစ် ဘတ်စ်ကား စီးပါ။"}]

[{"text":"この字は何と読みますか。","reading":"Kono ji wa nan to yomimasu ka.","kana":"このじはなんとよみますか。","romaji":"Kono ji wa nan to yomimasu ka.","english":"How do you read this character?","burmese":"ဒီစာလုံးကို ဘယ်လိုဖတ်လဲ။"},{"text":"田中さんは字がきれいです。","reading":"Tanaka san wa ji ga kirei desu.","kana":"たなかさんはじがきれいです。","romaji":"Tanaka san wa ji ga kirei desu.","english":"Mr. Tanaka has beautiful handwriting.","burmese":"တာနာကာစံက လက်ရေးလှတယ်။"},{"text":"大きい字で書いてください。","reading":"Ookii ji de kaite kudasai.","kana":"おおきいじでかいてください。","romaji":"Ookii ji de kaite kudasai.","english":"Please write in big letters.","burmese":"စာလုံးကြီးကြီး ရေးပါ။"}]

meaning_burmese: အသံ (ပစ္စည်း၊ သဘာဝ)

meaning_burmese: ယာဉ်စီးရန်နေရာ၊ မှတ်တိုင်
examples_json: [{"text":"タクシー乗り場はどこですか。","reading":"Takushii noriba wa doko desu ka.","kana":"たくしーのりばはどこですか。","romaji":"Takushii noriba wa doko desu ka.","english":"Where is the taxi stand?","burmese":"တက္ကစီဂိတ်က ဘယ်မှာလဲ။"},{"text":"バス乗り場は駅の前です。","reading":"Basu noriba wa eki no mae desu.","kana":"ばすのりばはえきのまえです。","romaji":"Basu noriba wa eki no mae desu.","english":"The bus stop is in front of the station.","burmese":"ဘတ်စ်ကားမှတ်တိုင်က ဘူတာရှေ့မှာပါ။"},{"text":"三番の乗り場から乗ってください。","reading":"Sanban no noriba kara notte kudasai.","kana":"さんばんののりばからのってください。","romaji":"Sanban no noriba kara notte kudasai.","english":"Please board from platform number three.","burmese":"နံပါတ်သုံး ဂိတ်ကနေ စီးပါ။"}]

[{"text":"次の交差点を右に曲がってください。","reading":"Tsugi no kousaten o migi ni magatte kudasai.","kana":"つぎのこうさてんをみぎにまがってください。","romaji":"Tsugi no kousaten o migi ni magatte kudasai.","english":"Please turn right at the next intersection.","burmese":"နောက်လမ်းဆုံမှာ ညာဘက်ကွေ့ပါ။"},{"text":"交差点の近くに銀行があります。","reading":"Kousaten no chikaku ni ginkou ga arimasu.","kana":"こうさてんのちかくにぎんこうがあります。","romaji":"Kousaten no chikaku ni ginkou ga arimasu.","english":"There's a bank near the intersection.","burmese":"လမ်းဆုံနားမှာ ဘဏ် ရှိတယ်။"},{"text":"この交差点は車が多いです。","reading":"Kono kousaten wa kuruma ga ooi desu.","kana":"このこうさてんはくるまがおおいです。","romaji":"Kono kousaten wa kuruma ga ooi desu.","english":"This intersection has a lot of cars.","burmese":"ဒီလမ်းဆုံမှာ ကားတွေ များတယ်။"}]
